issues.description: setuptools<82 cap leaks from CI workaround into core/setup.py runtime install_requires.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this as the headline issue. The mmcv/pkg_resources problem is build-time and CI-scoped, but pinning setuptools<82 in core/setup.py forces every downstream autogluon.core user to inherit the cap. Scope it to CI scripts (or pyproject build-system requires), not runtime install_requires.

issues.description: mmcv --no-build-isolation silently couples build to ambient environment without stated preconditions.
issues.detail: Switching to --no-build-isolation makes mmcv's build depend on whatever setuptools, wheel, and torch the ambient env provides instead of the isolated PEP 517 contract. The script pre-pins setuptools but assumes torch is preinstalled. State the precondition explicitly or install the build deps, and add a comment documenting the implicit coupling.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 with no justification in the diff.
issues.detail: The PR is scoped to fixing mmengine/setuptools but quietly bumps mmdet a minor version. If 3.3.0 is required for compatibility with mmengine 0.10.7 or mmcv 2.1.0, state that in a comment; otherwise split it out as a separate change. Unaudited drift bundled into a CI hotfix.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack a concrete revert condition and owner.
issues.detail: The FIXMEs reference mmcv#3325 but do not state what flips the cap off (e.g., "mmcv ships a release that no longer imports pkg_resources at build time") or who owns checking. Six months from now whoever greps FIXME will have to reverse-engineer the trigger. Add the explicit revert criterion.

issues.description: mmengine/mmdet substitutions drop prior torch-2.5 SHA pin without restating the invariant is preserved.
issues.detail: The diff replaces a pinned mmengine git SHA (originally chosen for a torch 2.5 fix) with mmengine==0.10.7. The previous contract is dropped without a one-line note confirming the upstream fix landed in 0.10.7. Make the substitution auditable so the torch-2.5 compatibility invariant is preserved on record.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a reasonable but under-audited CI hotfix: pin setuptools<82 to keep mmcv 2.1.0's pkg_resources-dependent build working, and swap the mmengine git SHA for the PyPI wheel. The dominant concern, flagged by all three reviewers, is altitude — the setuptools cap leaks from CI shell scripts into core/setup.py's runtime install_requires, propagating a build-time workaround onto every downstream user. Secondary issues are implicit ambient-env coupling from --no-build-isolation, an unexplained mmdet 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 bump riding the fix, and FIXMEs that lack revert criteria. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — scope the pin to CI, split the mmdet bump, and document the revert condition.
